name: MAN★EATER
source:
You play as a girl-next-door type just trying to get home one Halloween night. Your surprisingly peaceful subway ride goes awry, though, when two odd strangers join you. 

[From [url=https://double-deletion-studio.itch.io/maneater]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个邻家女孩，只是想在万圣节之夜回家。然而，当两个奇怪的陌生人加入你时，你出奇平静的地铁之旅却出现了问题。

[来自[url=https://double-deletion-studio.itch.io/maneater]Itch.io[/url]]
